title: Iranian Oil Tanker Struck by US Missiles Near Kharg Island
text:
Iranian Oil Tanker Struck by US Missiles Near Kharg Island"

""
"An Iranian oil tanker was hit by US missiles near Kharg Island on Saturday, September 5, 2026, according to Iranian media reports. The attack occurred amid heightened tensions between the two countries, which have been in a renewed phase of conflict since late February."

"🟢 The US military reportedly struck the tanker with four projectiles. The attack took place around 8:30 a.m. local time near Kharg Island in the Persian Gulf."

"- The Vessel: The targeted tanker was described as a “small vessel”."
"- Casualties: No casualties have been reported."
"- Current Status: Evacuation operations on the tanker are currently underway."

"- Context: Kharg Island is Iran's main oil export hub, handling roughly 90% of the country's crude exports. US President Donald Trump had previously threatened to seize or destroy the island. The attack comes as the US and Iran have exchanged heavy strikes in recent days, following the outbreak of hostilities on February 28.
